sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is a multilingual instruction-tuned language model developed by meta-llama with 8 billion parameters, released July 23, 2024. The model uses an optimized transformer architecture with grouped-query attention (GQA) for efficient inference, trained on approximately 15 trillion tokens of publicly available data with a knowledge cutoff of December 2023. sources.snippet: Q: What is the difference between this model and the 4-bit quantized version? A: Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-bnb-4bit applies 4-bit quantization after training, reducing memory usage further for finetuning and inference while slightly reducing output quality.
